title: Null pointer access: `profile.address` is typed as `Address | null` (line 13) but is accessed without a null check on li
description: Null pointer access: `profile.address` is typed as `Address | null` (line 13) but is accessed without a null check on line 42 (`profile.address.city` and `profile.address.state`). When a user has no address set, this will throw a TypeError at runtime. Add a null guard before accessing nested address properties.
